**Iryax Global Privacy Policy and Security Measures**
=====================================================

### Overview

At Iryax Global, we prioritize your privacy and security. This policy outlines how we collect, use, and protect your information when using our website and services.

### Information Collected
------------------------

We may collect the following personal information:

*   Name
*   Email address
*   Phone number
*   Billing details
*   Company information
*   Payment information processed securely through Razorpay
*   Browser and device information

### How We Use Your Information
------------------------------

We use your information to:

*   Provide and manage our services
*   Process payments securely
*   Improve website performance and user experience
*   Send invoices, updates, and support information
*   Prevent fraud and unauthorized activities

### Payment Information
---------------------

All online payments are processed securely through Razorpay. We do not store your complete card details on our servers.

### Data Protection
------------------

We implement reasonable security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, misuse, or disclosure.

### Third-Party Services
----------------------

We may use trusted third-party services for payment processing, analytics, hosting, and communication purposes.

### Cookies
---------

Our website may use cookies to improve user experience and analyze website traffic. Please refer to our Cookie Policy for more details.

### User Rights
--------------

You may request to:

*   Access your personal data
*   Correct inaccurate information
*   Delete your data where applicable

### Policy Updates
-----------------

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Changes will be posted on this page.

### Secure Payments
------------------

All online payments are processed securely through Razorpay, ensuring that your payment information is protected and secure.

For additional information, please contact us at info@ingrainsystem.com or call +91-9010481048.

intents.name: about
intents.answer:
# Iryax Global Overview
=====================

Iryax Global is an enterprise technology company.
-----------------------------------------------

### What We Do

We create a unified ecosystem where businesses operate as one system by connecting the best tools into one platform.

### Problems We Solve

#### Current State

* Great tools, but broken systems
* Disconnected data and no visibility
* Teams in silos and time lost switching systems
* Multiple logins with no connection

#### Pain Points

* Inefficient use of existing tools
* Lack of integration across systems
* Incomplete visibility into business operations

### Solution

We connect what you already use, providing:

1. One user ID & password for seamless access
2. Access to multiple tools in one platform
3. Integrated data across systems
4. One dashboard with complete visibility

By connecting your existing tools, we help businesses run more efficiently and effectively.

For additional information, please contact us at info@ingrainsystem.com or call +91-9010481048.
